newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-NORTHWESTERN RUNNING BACK AUTRY ENTERING DRAFT.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-NORTHWESTERN RUNNING BACK AUTRY ENTERING DRAFT.

text.p: Northwestern running back Darnell Autry, one of the cornerstones to the Wildcats' rise to the top of the Big 10 Conference, announced Monday he would forego his senior year of eligibility and enter the NFL Draft.
Autry was the third underclassmen Monday to announce he was entering the draft, joining Ohio State offensive tackle Orlando Pace and defensive back Shawn Springs.
The 5-foot-11 (1.80 m), 211-pound (96 kg) Autry ranked seventh nationally in rushing this season, carrying 263 times for 1,386 yards, an average of 138.60 per game.

Autry, the school's all-time leading rusher with 3,727 yards, also set a Northwestern record with 19 consecutive 100-yard games until a sprained shoulder in a 34-30 victory at Wisconsin on October 19 forced him out of the game.
